parsed.rationale: The rhythm is regular at about 100 bpm with narrow QRS complexes. V1-V3 show rS complexes with small proportionate ST elevation and upright T waves, which looks like a normal early-repolarization variant. There is no regional ST elevation, reciprocal depression or pathologic Q waves, so STEMI criteria are not met despite the stated pre-read, and the baseline noise in limb leads I, aVR, aVL and III limits those leads.
